title: Add Rental, Home Delivery, and Authorized Dealer Highlights

requirements.text: Add a 'Machines Available on Rent' section to the HomePage that highlights rental availability for agricultural machines. This should include a visually distinct card or banner with a heading like 'Machines Available on Rent', a short description, and a call-to-action to contact for rental inquiries.

quotes: Machines are also available on rent basis

acceptanceCriteria: A rental section/card is visible on the HomePage
The section clearly communicates that machines are available for rent
A contact link or call-to-action is present for rental inquiries

requirements.text: Add a 'Home Delivery Available' badge or highlight across relevant pages (HomePage hero section, ProductCatalogPage, and Footer). Use a recognizable delivery icon and short text such as 'Home Delivery Available' to make it prominent.
acceptanceCriteria: Home delivery information is visible on the HomePage
Home delivery information is visible on the ProductCatalogPage
The Footer includes a mention of home delivery
A delivery icon or badge accompanies the text

requirements.text: Add an 'Authorized Dealer of Srachi in Kashmir Province' highlight to the HomePage hero section and the BusinessProfilePage. Display it as a prominent badge or trust seal, using text: 'Authorized Dealer – Srachi, Kashmir Province'.

quotes: authorized dealer of srachi in kashmir province

acceptanceCriteria: The authorized dealer badge/seal is displayed on the HomePage hero section
The authorized dealer information is also present on the BusinessProfilePage
The badge clearly names Srachi and Kashmir Province

requirements.text: Update the ProductCard component to display a 'Available for Rent' badge alongside or below the existing price/availability info when a product supports rental. If the backend does not currently support a rental flag on products, display the general rental availability note on all product cards.

quotes: Machines are also available on rent basis

acceptanceCriteria: Product cards show a rental availability indicator
The indicator is visually distinct from other badges

constraints: Do not modify files in frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
All new UI content must use English
Maintain the existing earthy-green and amber design token system defined in frontend/src/index.css
nonGoals: No new backend endpoints or data model changes are required unless a rental flag on products is explicitly needed
No online rental booking or payment flow

required: Srachi authorized dealer trust badge/seal with green and gold tones on a transparent background (srachi-dealer-badge.dim_300x120.png)
Home delivery illustration icon showing a truck or delivery vehicle in earthy-green tones (home-delivery-icon.dim_128x128.png)
